subject: general
question: What does the idiom 'Spill the beans' mean?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. Reveal a secret.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Spill the beans"** means to reveal a secret or disclose confidential information, often unintentionally. (राज़ खोल देना)

 
 
• **Example:** He accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party planned for her birthday.
 
 
 
• **"Reveal a secret"** means to share or disclose information that was supposed to remain hidden. (गुप्त बात का खुलासा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She revealed the secret of her success during the interview.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3 i.e. Reveal a secret.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Waste food** (खाना बर्बाद करना): To throw away or misuse food unnecessarily.

 
 
• **Example:** Please don’t waste food; there are people who don’t have enough to eat.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Hide a fact** (तथ्य छुपाना): To deliberately keep information or truth from others.
 
 
• **Example:** He tried to hide the fact that he had failed the exam.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Lose patience** (धैर्य खोना): To become irritated or frustrated and no longer able to wait calmly.
 
 
• **Example:** She lost patience after waiting for hours in the long queue.
 
 

155:Tb69,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
